- Manifest: we provide a YAML manifest (artifact list + sha256 checksums + semantic version + build metadata). See attached example (offline_update_manifest_v1.yaml).
- Signatures: artifacts are signed using a detached PKCS#7 signature (HSM-backed root keys). We publish an intermediate signing key fingerprint in the manifest; root key material never leaves an HSM.
- Rotation: default cadence is quarterly rotation for intermediate signing keys; emergency rotation process exists for compromise scenarios.
- Transport: we support encrypted LTO cartridges or encrypted disk shipments with a two-person handoff; chain-of-custody form is included.

Adding the technical details requested. Apologies for the length—wanted to be explicit for the audit.

Signing and verification:
- Signature format: detached PKCS#7 (SHA-256) over each artifact (bundle.tar.gz). We also include a top-level manifest signed the same way.
- HSM: AWS CloudHSM / Thales HSM options supported; root key stored in FIPS-compliant HSM; intermediate keys are generated inside HSM and exported only as wrapped keys when necessary.
- Fingerprints: manifest contains signer_fingerprint (SHA-1 fingerprint of public cert) and key_id.

Manifest schema (example fields):
- name, version, build_id, published_at, artifacts: [ { path, size_bytes, sha256, signature_path } ]
- signing_info: { signer_fingerprint, signature_algo, hsm_vendor, key_rotation_date }

Transport and chain-of-custody:
- Media: standard option is encrypted LTO-7; alternate is NIST AES-256 encrypted HDD with tamper-evident enclosure.
- Handover: two signers on handoff; shipping manifest signed (digital + handwritten signoff) and scanned into the attestation packet.
- Verification on receipt: recipient is given sha256 of manifest and detached signatures prior to shipping; they verify signatures inside their air-gapped environment before applying.

Operational notes:
- We recommend validating artifact checksums first, then signature verification using the published signer cert (we will provide the intermediate cert bundle).
- In the case of emergency rotation, we will revoke intermediate certs via published CRL and provide a signed rotation statement via the same transport.

Attachments: offline_update_manifest_v1.yaml (example), signing_key_rotation_plan.pdf (policy draft), transport_chain_of_custody.docx
